links.outcome: Knowledge gain, anxiety change, and satisfaction, chatbot plus brochure vs brochure alone
links.effect: No significant differences in knowledge gain, anxiety change, or satisfaction (P > .05). 17 of 33 (52%) chatbot-group patients did not engage; SUS 83.1 ± 12.1. Only 35 of 64 completed postoperative questionnaires.
links.quote: No significant differences were detected in knowledge gain, anxiety change, or satisfaction ( P > .05).

unlisted_practices: Restricting a patient education chatbot to clinician-validated answers only (safety-first design), with a proposed hybrid of validated and flexible content

screen.reason: Prospective randomized controlled trial testing the real deployment of a clinician-validated patient-facing chatbot for cataract surgery education compared to standard brochures.
